nodes.label: Anti-Stall / Stuck Detection Mechanism
nodes.rationale: Timeboxes: 30s per variable, 5 min per function, 10 min per file; skip with TODO to avoid getting stuck

nodes.label: Bug Confidence Score Calculation
nodes.rationale: Weighted: pattern match 0.3, personality agreement 0.25, tool confirmation 0.25, reproducibility 0.2; <0.7 marked needs_verification

nodes.label: Progressive Multi-Pass Refinement Strategy (Pass 1-4 by severity)
nodes.norm_label: progressive multi-pass refinement strategy (pass 1-4 by severity)

nodes.label: Pattern Learning & Evolution Engine
nodes.rationale: Abstract a pattern once 3+ similar bugs found; apply retroactively when confidence > 0.8

nodes.label: Smart State Recovery
nodes.rationale: Resume exactly where stopped after restart; rollback corrupted checkpoints, rescan changed files

nodes.label: Need-Service Alignment (Spearman, MIN_ALIGNMENT_N=8)
nodes.rationale: Confounded by reverse causality; suppressed below n=8 for same reason as RSI cohort floor.

nodes.label: V8 Programme Health (psyche_programme_health)
nodes.rationale: Built for a single-counsellor school; per-counsellor comparison meaningless and capacity cannot grow, so the question is allocation.

nodes.norm_label: reach gini and depth gini (allocation concentration)

nodes.norm_label: deliberately absent metrics (no causal claim, no queueing)

nodes.label: Measured / Modelled Split
nodes.rationale: SQL returns only measured quantities; all capacity arithmetic is client-side at read time so a wrong capacity setting can mislabel headroom but never corrupt the allocation picture.

nodes.label: ModelledBanner (modelled panels announce assumptions)
nodes.rationale: Capacity is a counsellor-reported planning figure; readers must never mistake it for an observation.

nodes.label: Structurally Disabled Features (High Vulnerability archetype, CAR-SEL/BHV-EMH axes)
nodes.norm_label: structurally disabled features (high vulnerability archetype, car-sel/bhv-emh axes)

nodes.label: Reverse-Scoring Formula
nodes.rationale: Scores stored raw (1-4); reverse scoring applied at read time in application code, not at DB write time.

nodes.label: 3 of 7 Domains Have No Instrument (BHV, CAR, SEL)
nodes.norm_label: 3 of 7 domains have no instrument (bhv, car, sel)
nodes.rationale: Module library does not cover the domain model; this invalidates several shipped features.

nodes.label: Outcome Labels Missing
nodes.rationale: No schema field encodes deterioration/recovery; labels must be defined by counselors and a capture field built before any supervised validation.

nodes.label: AI Subsystem V10-V13 (edge functions, modelRouter fallback)
nodes.norm_label: ai subsystem v10-v13 (edge functions, modelrouter fallback)
nodes.rationale: generateWithFallback() is the only way functions call an LLM; candidate order admin pick -> default profiles -> live-catalogue self-heal.

nodes.label: Master Schema psyche_v3_master_schema.sql
nodes.rationale: Single source of truth for schema, but V5/V6 migrations are not merged into it; master + migrations together are canonical until a formal merge is approved.

nodes.label: Known Caveats (provisional weights, grade parsing, duplicated 0.5 threshold)
nodes.norm_label: known caveats (provisional weights, grade parsing, duplicated 0.5 threshold)

nodes.label: Migration Run Order v5 -> v5_analytics -> v6 -> v6.1 -> v7 -> v7.1
nodes.norm_label: migration run order v5 -> v5_analytics -> v6 -> v6.1 -> v7 -> v7.1

nodes.label: Living Doc System Rules (one owner per rule)
nodes.norm_label: living doc system rules (one owner per rule)
nodes.rationale: One file owns each rule; duplication makes neither source reliable; updates only on explicit human doc sweep.

nodes.label: Paired Constant MIN_COMPOSITE_CONFIDENCE / c_min_confidence
nodes.rationale: 0.5 floor exists in SQL and TS and must be kept in sync manually.

nodes.label: RSI (cohort readiness ranking)
nodes.rationale: Original design had a circular dependency (Composite needed RSI, RSI needed Composite); resolved by making RSI strictly downstream.

nodes.label: V7.1 Composite Confidence Gating (CF_C >= 0.5)
nodes.rationale: A cold-start student with no assessment data but two No_Shows scored C=100 High Load off ED alone; an evidential floor gates display and RSI eligibility. The 0.5 constant is duplicated in MIN_COMPOSITE_CONFIDENCE and c_min_confidence and must be kept in sync.

nodes.label: V7.2/V7.3 Follow-up Closure Fix
nodes.rationale: No write path ever set follow_up_status to Done and DEFAULT 'Pending' created phantom follow-ups that depressed ETI; v7_2 counts only scheduled follow-ups and v7_3 adds an auto-close trigger. Historical backfill left commented out because it rewrites records.

nodes.label: daily_session_capacity setting
nodes.rationale: Corrected 7 -> 15 after counsellor reported true rate of 15-20/day; no capacity history so retrospective utilisation charts are not offered.

nodes.label: Programme Health Analytics (V6.0)
nodes.rationale: Built for a single counsellor permanently, so capacity is fixed; asks what service level is achievable rather than whether to hire. Governing rule: measured vs modelled - SQL never multiplies by daily_session_capacity; capacity maths is client-side.

nodes.label: V13 AI Model Selection
nodes.rationale: Groq retired hardcoded llama models causing every AI report to 404; defaults moved to gpt-oss/gemini-flash-lite, model choice stored in PsychE_Settings.ai_models, router self-heals from the provider's live list.

nodes.label: psyche_run_daily_batch()
nodes.rationale: Now two passes: per-student metrics, then per-cohort ranking, so RSI stays strictly downstream of Composite.

nodes.label: schema/install.sql (idempotent single-file installer)
nodes.rationale: Idempotent, no DROP TABLE; older v5-v8 migration files kept as historical record only and must not be run after it because four functions were superseded.

nodes.label: V6.1 Telemetry Upsert Fix (cross-engine data loss)
nodes.norm_label: v6.1 telemetry upsert fix (cross-engine data loss)
nodes.rationale: calculate_student_telemetry() and psyche_run_daily_batch() share one row per student/day; whichever ran first nulled the other's columns on INSERT, so the write was changed to an upsert.

nodes.label: React Compiler (not enabled)
nodes.rationale: Not enabled due to impact on dev and build performance.

nodes.label: Credential exposure + permissive RLS risk
nodes.rationale: .env committed in public git history; anon key plus FOR ALL USING (true) RLS grants full read/write. Durable fix is auth.uid()-based RLS, not key rotation.

nodes.label: RLS pre-production warning (FOR ALL USING true)
nodes.norm_label: rls pre-production warning (for all using true)
nodes.rationale: Permissive RLS lets the anon key work immediately on fresh deploys; must be replaced with auth.uid()-based predicates before storing real student mental-health records.

nodes.label: Supabase function secrets (GROQ_API_KEY, GEMINI_API_KEY)
nodes.rationale: LLM keys live only in Supabase function secrets so the browser bundle can never reach them; Gemini is an optional fallback.

nodes.label: Domain Scoring Engine (hierarchical factor model)
nodes.rationale: Rewritten to a second-order hierarchical factor model (item -> module -> domain) with cross-instrument normalization via scale_min/scale_max and a 4-axis Tension Matrix, per an external psychometrics consultant's spec.

nodes.label: Assessment Library CMS (Master-Detail)
nodes.rationale: Migrated from monolithic JSON to relational Modules/Questions for scalable questionnaires.

nodes.label: One-Time Edit Lock for formal test modules
nodes.norm_label: one-time edit lock for formal test modules
nodes.rationale: Prevents accidental corruption of standardized testing material.

nodes.label: Tag Assignment ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
nodes.norm_label: tag assignment on conflict do nothing

nodes.label: Single-Accent Chart Colour Rule
nodes.rationale: Two-hue palette #5b8af5 vs #9b59f5 scored deltaE 13.3, below the 15 floor, so identity is carried by position, labels and mark type rather than hue.

nodes.label: State Management Rules (no global store)
nodes.rationale: useState/useEffect with direct Supabase calls per page; custom hooks only if same query appears in 3+ places.

nodes.label: Telemetry Tab Evidence-First Structure (V7.2)
nodes.rationale: Evidence-first: each panel answers what happened, why, how sure, what next before showing a number; Evidence Coverage strip first because every number is conditional on it.

nodes.label: Bento Grid Layout
nodes.rationale: Compartmentalizes information into distinct cards on a single screen to avoid unnecessary navigation.

nodes.norm_label: social/docs svg icon sprite (bluesky, discord, documentation, github, social, x)

nodes.norm_label: hero image (isometric layered purple platform illustration)

nodes.label: One-Directional Analytics Pipeline
nodes.rationale: No stage reads from a stage below it; everything upstream of Composite uses only one student's data, making Composite safe to rank.

nodes.label: Masking Pattern (COG high / EMH low)
nodes.rationale: Academic competence conceals distress from performance-based monitoring.

nodes.label: Composite Score (psyche_compute_composite_score, V7)
nodes.rationale: Strictly self-contained, criterion-referenced per student; Relative Deficit term removed to break circular dependency with RSI. Weights 0.44/0.28/0.17/0.11 are provisional consultant judgment.

nodes.label: Daily Batch psyche_run_daily_batch (two-pass)
nodes.rationale: Pass 1 per-student (gatekeeper, ETI, composite) then Pass 2 RSI ranking; both in one transaction so Pass 2 sees all Pass 1 writes.

nodes.label: Domain Scoring Engine (calculate_student_telemetry, V6)
nodes.rationale: Second-order hierarchical factor model (item->module->domain) designed with an external psychometrics consultant; per-module means remove V5.0 item-count bias; per-module scale_min/max normalization makes it instrument-agnostic; unadministered modules excised via lambda rather than treated as zero.

nodes.label: RSI - Relative Scoring Index (psyche_compute_rsi_for_student)
nodes.rationale: Only norm-referenced metric; cohort fallback course->grade->school with n>=8 floor because small cohorts give coarse/outlier-dominated percentiles; must never be read without Composite Score.

nodes.label: Tension Matrix (Cross-Domain Tension, 4 axes + dominant_tension)
nodes.rationale: Bifactor-residual approximation: divergent profiles (e.g. masking: high COG, low EMH) are more diagnostic than uniformly low ones; sign carries clinical meaning; V5.0 T_internal_external average removed because it destroyed divergence information.

nodes.label: RSI Unexercised - No Student Receives an RSI
nodes.norm_label: rsi unexercised - no student receives an rsi

nodes.label: Composite Score & RSI Cards
nodes.rationale: Confidence gate is a safety requirement: ETI-only composites must not render as High Load; RSI must always be paired with Composite Score since it always produces a 0-100 spread.

nodes.label: C-RSI Circular Dependency (Relative Deficit removed)
nodes.rationale: Resolved architecturally by removing RD and redistributing weights 0.40/0.25/0.15/0.10 -> 0.44/0.28/0.17/0.11, rather than simultaneous equations which would be fragile and order-dependent.

nodes.label: Cold-Start False Positive Incident
nodes.rationale: ETI derives from logs not assessments, so cold-start students could have lambda_ED=1 and render High Load; resolved by confidence gating.

nodes.label: Absolute (criterion) vs Relative (norm) Measurement Separation
nodes.rationale: Everything except RSI is criterion-referenced; mixing them caused the circular-dependency flaw.

nodes.label: Missing Data Is Never Faked
nodes.rationale: Every layer uses lambda so unmeasured components are excised, never treated as zero; all-missing yields NULL.

nodes.label: Availability Coefficient (lambda) Missing-Data Excision
nodes.rationale: Missing data is never faked: unmeasured components are excised from numerator and denominator, and all-missing yields NULL rather than a default.

nodes.label: Cross-Engine Upsert Carry-Forward Fix (V6.1)
nodes.rationale: INSERT branches originally set only own columns, nulling the other engine's data on new day rows; fix carries forward last-known values from most recent prior row.

nodes.label: Distress vs Wellness Direction Convention
nodes.rationale: composite_score is distress-direction while domain_scores and rsi_score are wellness-direction; domain D_k inverted once at storage (1 - D_k) so frontend storage contract stays unchanged.

nodes.label: Evidential Floor CF_C >= 0.5 (V7.1 confidence gating)
nodes.rationale: V7.0 assumption that C=NULL only at cold_start was false: ETI-only students produced High Load false positives. Gate presentation and RSI eligibility on confidence, not on the formula; scores still stored.

nodes.label: PHQ-9 Mis-assigned to BHV (should be EMH)
nodes.norm_label: phq-9 mis-assigned to bhv (should be emh)

nodes.label: One-Time-Edit Lock Rule
nodes.rationale: Formal locked tests (PsycheSPA) may have each question edited only once, enforced at application layer via has_been_edited.

nodes.label: Overdue Detection at Query Time
nodes.rationale: Overdue derived at query time (scheduled_date < today and still Scheduled) so no background job is needed.

nodes.label: Row Level Security (open allow-all policies)
nodes.rationale: All 10 tables use USING(true) open access via anon key; must be replaced with auth.uid() predicates for production.

nodes.label: /student/:studentId route uses human-readable student_id
nodes.rationale: Param name misleading: it is PsychE_Students.student_id, not UUID; passing a UUID renders Student not found.
